Static review of frozen bytes (.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task) against workbook Quality Checks row 30 (#29) and Internal Quality Checks row 30 ('Every dimension carries the browser gate that hard-zeros blank/static-shell/cross-origin apps (plus auth/backing checks when relevant)'; the public Quality Checks wording supersedes the cross-origin leg: 'Network is public, so the gate must NOT require same-origin'), skill references/quality-checks.md:123-125 and staged-task-contract.md:156.
GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:28 aggregation all_pass, criterion hro_gate_render (binary, lines 32-39): incorrect password leaves visitor signed out, then correct Recruiter password signs in to a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:28 all_pass, hro_gate_shared (lines 32-39): add a uniquely named/emailed candidate to seeded Data Analyst via ordinary UI, reload (still signed in, card there), then in a new independent empty browser context sign in as Observer and find exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' This is the auth leg plus a real server-backing leg (write + independent-context readback), which matches lesson 4 (load, reload, server-backed) and REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0; test.sh:213-222 runs gates then score.py, exit 1 stops before scored.
EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES AN IN-DIMENSION HARD-ZERO GATE: functional/prompt.md:13-17 ('## Global browser gate' same add/reload/Observer-readback check; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives this criterion 0'; functional judge.toml mode=individual so the gate runs in every per-criterion session); polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives binary0 throughout'); visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'). No scored prompt grants partial credit on gate failure. Each includes sign-in (auth) and the server-backing leg; the wrong-password refusal lives only in the render gate, which is acceptable since the gates suite hard-zeros first.
NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT: grep of tests/ for origin/same-site finds none in any gate or prompt (only 'rejected-from'/out-of-date wording in functional criteria). The template's 'Replays use an in-page call from the app's own origin' line is absent from the task functional prompt. Only localhost:3000 addresses are used (lesson 13). Checker-not-fixer block present at line 7 of all five prompts (lesson 6). No timing step inside any gate (lesson 7).
PUBLIC BASIS FOR GATE LEGS: instruction.md:19 (accounts, password), hireops_rules.md:11 (email+password sign-in), :19 (Observer reads the board), :32 (recruiter adds candidate with name, email, source; card at bottom of Applied), instruction.md:7 and rules:177-180 (reload distinguished from session end, so remaining signed in after reload is publicly implied), app_context.md:29 (three seeded jobs; Data Analyst exists at seed_data.json:93).
ADVERSARIAL: broken apps -- client-only/localStorage app fails the independent-context readback; seed-only static/SSR app fails the add; accept-any-password app fails render gate; health-only/static picture fails render. A server-memory (non-SQLite) app passes the gate but loses data at restart, which hro_intake_restart grades -- correct division (gate stays simple). Conforming alternatives -- custom routes/labels (prompts say discover by intent), job picker vs per-job URL, required source field (constraints gate says 'any source'), Observer any working staff account fallback; none found that the gate would wrongly fail.
